name: viral-hyper-agent
description: A social media team for one creator, running on your own computer and Claude subscription. Trend radar, Style DNA extraction (caption font, size, colours, pace, edit), human-sounding scripts scored as speech, and Viral Studio: a local video engine and web app that makes motion-graphics reels from a prompt plus reference and competitor videos, auto-edits raw footage like a pro editor, and reverse-engineers whole channels (thumbnails, topics, dialogue, energy). Plus every platform's posts, approved scheduling and a learning loop.
